chunks: And the people of Midian, and Moses was accused of lies. So I allowed the infidels respite, then seized them. How was My reprobation then!

key_terms.أَمْلَيْتُ: I allowed respite / I granted time
key_terms.كَذَّبَ: Accused of lies / Called a liar

ai.seo_question: How did God deal with the people of Midian after they accused Moses of lying?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj underscores the divine attribute of 'Amal' (granting respite) before 'Aqab' (punishment), illustrating how God allowed the disbelievers of Midian to flourish temporarily despite rejecting Moses. This delay serves as a test of endurance and a manifestation of mercy before the inevitable execution of justice, reinforcing the theme of divine retribution for those who deny prophetic truth.
